translate_en|mods/PivotMod/42/media/lua/: I feel like my movements have become more agile, as if time started flowing faster.
It seems like my former agility has subsided a bit, and my movements have become more skillful.
Instant Character Pivot Speed
Nimble mode: base turn speed (no trait)
Nimble-based turning only. Starting turn-speed multiplier for characters with neither trait. 1 = vanilla turn speed.
Dynamic: drunkenness slows turning
Requires the master switch. The more intoxicated you are, the slower and clumsier your turn. Thematic partner to the 'Under the Influence' trait.
Dynamic: encumbrance slows turning
Requires the master switch. The heavier your carried weight relative to your max, the slower you turn - a full load turns at roughly half speed. Pairs naturally with Strength.
Dynamic: fatigue slows turning
Requires the master switch. Being tired, or out of breath (low endurance), makes turning sluggish; well-rested and fresh turns are snappy.
Dynamic: leg/foot injuries slow turning
Requires the master switch. Wounds to the legs, feet or groin slow your turn; the worst affected part dominates, and a fracture there slows it much more.
Dynamic: panic speeds up turning
Requires the master switch. Panic makes you whip around faster - up to about +50%% turn speed at full panic (still capped to stay smooth).
Dynamic: deliberate turns while sneaking
Requires the master switch. While sneaking you turn more slowly and deliberately (about 70%% speed).
Dynamic turn modifiers (master switch)

Master switch for the situational modifiers below. When OFF, none of them do anything and turning behaves exactly as set above. When ON, each modifier you enable adjusts your walking/aiming turn speed based on your character's current condition. Works with both the fixed-speed and Nimble-based systems. Turning is never fully locked, and never pushed past the smooth cap.
Enable faster turning
Master switch for the whole mod. When OFF, turning is left completely vanilla.
Walking turn speed (WASD)
Vanilla
Slightly Faster
Faster
Very Fast
Instant

Only used when 'Use Nimble-based turning' is OFF.
How fast the character turns while walking (not aiming). Jogging and sprinting always turn at vanilla speed - the engine doesn't let mods change those.
The scale runs from Vanilla up to Instant; the in-between steps let you pick a gentler turn.
Nimble mode: overall turn-speed multiplier
Nimble-based turning only. A final multiplier applied on top of the computed turn speed. 1 = no extra change.
Use Nimble-based turning instead

Switches the entire mod between two systems.
OFF: the fixed turn speeds set above - separate values for aiming and walking.
ON: turn speed instead scales with the Nimble skill and the multipliers below, applied to both aiming and walking. Jogging and sprinting always stay vanilla.
Nimble mode: bonus when earning 'On Your Toes'
Nimble-based turning only. Extra turn speed gained when a character earns the 'On Your Toes' trait by reaching Nimble level 6.
Nimble mode: base turn speed ('On Your Toes')
Nimble-based turning only. Starting turn-speed multiplier for characters with the 'On Your Toes' trait. Higher = faster.
Aiming pivot speed
Vanilla
Slightly Faster
Faster
Very Fast
Instant

Only used when 'Use Nimble-based turning' is OFF.
How fast the character turns to the aim direction while in the combat stance.
The scale runs from Vanilla up to Instant; 'Instant' is as fast as the turn can go while staying smooth. The in-between steps let you pick a gentler, more gradual turn.
Nimble mode: bonus when losing 'Under the Influence'
Nimble-based turning only. Extra turn speed gained when a character loses the 'Under the Influence' trait at Nimble level 6.
Nimble mode: base turn speed ('Under the Influence')
Nimble-based turning only. Starting turn-speed multiplier for characters with the 'Under the Influence' trait. Below 1 = slower than vanilla.
Restrict to trait holders only

When ON, the turning buff applies only to trait holders; everyone else turns at vanilla speed. With the fixed turn speeds, that means 'On Your Toes' holders only. With Nimble-based turning, holders of either trait ('On Your Toes' or 'Under the Influence').
When OFF, it applies to every player.
On Your Toes

Light on your feet. Boosts your Nimble skill by 1.

(Only overhauls your pivoting if the trait toggle is enabled in this mod's sandbox settings. If it's disabled, pivoting is global for everyone and this trait is just a +1 Nimble add-on.)
Under the Influence

A few drinks deep and never quite sober. Lowers your Nimble skill by 1.

(Only overhauls your pivoting if the trait toggle is enabled in this mod's sandbox settings. If it's disabled, pivoting is global for everyone and this trait is just a -1 Nimble add-on.)
